candidates.statement: In general, FDA’s guidance documents do not establish legally enforceable responsibilities. 24 Instead, guidances describe the Agency’s current thinking on a topic and should be viewed only 25 as recommendations, unless specific regulatory or statutory requirements are cited. This 26 document is intended only to provide clarity to the public regarding existing requirements under 27 the law. The use of the word should in Agency guidances means that something is suggested or 28 recommended, but not required. 29
candidates.context: This guidance is intended to assist new drug application (NDA) applicants 2 and NDA holders 3 in 17 submitting patent information to their NDAs using the appropriate forms, Form FDA 3542, 18 Patent Information Submitted Upon and After Approval of an NDA or Supplement, or Form 19 FDA 3542a, Patent Information Submitted With the Filing of an NDA, Amendment, or 20 Supplement, under 21 CFR 314.53(d). 4 This guidance provides answers to commonly asked 21 questions regarding Forms FDA 3542 and FDA 3542a. 22

candidates.statement: Section 505(c)(2) of the FD&C Act (21 U.S.C. 355(c)(2)) requires an NDA holder to submit, no 42 later than 30 days after the date of approval of the NDA, certain information “for each patent for 43 which a claim of patent infringement could reasonably be asserted if a person not licensed by the 44 owner of the patent engaged in the manufacture, use, or sale of the drug, and that — (I) claims 45 the drug for which the applicant submitted the application and is a drug substance (active 46 ingredient) patent or a drug product (formulation or composition) patent; or (II) claims a method 47 of using such drug for which approval… has been granted in the application.” 6 Section 48 505(c)(2) further requires that “a patent that is identified as claiming a method of using such drug 49 shall be filed only if the patent claims a method of use approved in the application.” 7

candidates.statement: For patents claiming a drug substance, the NDA applicant or NDA holder must submit 74 information only on those patents that claim the drug substance that is the subject of the pending 75 or approved NDA or that claim a drug substance that is the same as the active ingredient that is 76 the subject of the pending or approved NDA. 14 For patents that claim only a polymorph that is 77 the same as the active ingredient described by the NDA (i.e., patents that have no other basis for 78 listing), the NDA applicant or NDA holder must certify in the required FDA declaration form 79 that the NDA applicant or NDA holder has test data demonstrating that the drug product 80 containing the polymorph will perform the same as a drug product described in the NDA. 15 For 81 patents claiming a drug product, the NDA applicant or NDA holder must submit information 82 only on those patents that claim the drug product that is described in the pending or approved 83 NDA. 16 For patents claiming a method of use, the NDA applicant or NDA holder must submit 84 information only on those patents that claim indications or other conditions of use for which 85 approval is sought or has been granted in the NDA, and the NDA applicant or NDA holder must 86 separately identify each pending or approved method of use and the related patent claim(s). 17
